title: SPY Weekly Report — Week of Oct 26–30, 2026
html:
Full report: Claude Doc · Levels: 2026-10-30 Levels · Last week: 2026-10-23 SPY Weekly Report

1. Bottom line and house view

SPY closed at $755.72 (−0.6% for the week, −1.8% Friday) and lost the $756.10 Fib level. Friday's low of $750.36 held above the $745–748 cluster. Intel and Amazon results revived fears that AI spending won't pay off. Chips: SMH −7.0% Friday; AMD and DELL −10.8%. NOW fell 34% for the week and GOOGL 12.6%. Energy, health care and staples rose. The Federal Reserve held at 3.75–4.00% with 2 hike dissents.

House viewCallWhat would change it
Near-term (1–3 wks)Cautious. Below the 20-day ($770.47) and 50-day ($766.77); RSI 40Bullish on a close above $766–770; bearish on a close below $745–748 (then $740)
12-monthConstructive. 50-day above 200-day ($725.98); Street median 8,000 (≈ SPY $798)A weekly close below $722–729 turns the view neutral

What changed vs. Oct 23: SPY $759.97 → $755.72. The $770–774 trigger was tested (high $773.36) but not cleared, and $745–748 held. The house view is unchanged. Leadership rotated from AI into energy, defensives and travel.

5. Options under $800 — best fits to study (Options Playbook)

  1. SPY Dec 18 $780C ~$735, delta 0.31, breakeven $787.35
  2. QQQ Dec 18 $735C ~$753, delta 0.24 (edge flashing)
  3. NVDA Jun 17 '27 $270C ~$795, delta 0.25 (edge flashing; on the 200-day)
  4. IWM Dec 18 $282C ~$730, delta 0.49
  5. XOM Jun 17 '27 $220C ~$735, delta 0.30 (wait for a dip)
  6. KO Jun 17 '27 $95C ~$660, delta 0.55

Avoid:

  • Short-dated contracts before earnings: AAPL and PLTR (Nov 2), AMD and SMCI (Nov 3), ABNB (Nov 5).
  • Lottery tickets: June contracts on TSLA, RCL, GOOGL and QQQ.
  • Nothing fits the cap on DELL, MU or AMD.

  • Hartnett: risk-off until mid-November; private clients hold a record 66.4% in equities.
  • Goldman prime brokerage: about $20B of tech sold in two weeks.
  • Citadel (Rubner): retail is buying chips and expects an AI rebound after the midterms.
  • CTAs: close to their sell triggers.
  • Dalio: says this is a bond bear market and AI is a bubble.
